title: a16z Podcast: Finally a Tablet that Replaces Your Laptop

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: When the iPad first came out in 2010 there was chatter that went in two directions.
reader_summary.overview: When the iPad first came out in 2010 there was chatter that went in two directions. The big iPhone comment was quickly dispelled as people (and their kids) fell under the consumption thrall of iPads. But iPads never could meet the needs of most laptop users –- until now.

key_points.text: When the iPad first came out in 2010 there was chatter that went in two directions.
Benedict Evans and Steven Sinofsky offer their reasons why the iPad Pro hits the mark as a machine for all kinds of things.
The views expressed here are those of the individual AH Capital Management, L.L.C.
